disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the Title or any rule issued by the administrator
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any loan broker or mortgage loan originators of any loan broker that violate any provision of this Title or any rule issued by the administrator

disciplinary_grounds.description: Causing actual damage to a consumer through unfair, unconscionable or deceptive practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: through any unfair, unconscionable or deceptive practice cause actual damage to a consumer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false or misleading advertising concerning terms and conditions of services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A loan broker may not engage in this State in false or misleading advertising concerning the terms and conditions of any services or assistance offered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly permitting, encouraging, or assisting a consumer to submit false information on a credit application, or falsifying such information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A loan broker or any mortgage loan originator of a loan broker may not knowingly permit, encourage or assist a consumer to submit false information on any application for credit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a misrepresentation of fact in obtaining or attempting to obtain a registration as a facilitator
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A facilitator of a refund anticipation loan or refund anticipation check may not make a misrepresentation of fact in obtaining or attempting to obtain a registration as a facilitator.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unfair or deceptive acts or practices in facilitating a refund anticipation loan or check
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A facilitator of a refund anticipation loan or refund anticipation check may not engage in unfair or deceptive acts or practices in the facilitating of a refund anticipation loan or refund anticipation check

bonding_required.quote: Each application must be accompanied by evidence of a surety bond, in a form approved by the administrator in the aggregate amount of $25,000, to run to the State for use by the State and any person or persons who may have a cause of action against a loan broker.

definition_quote.value: "Loan broker" means any person who, with respect to the extension of consumer credit by others, provides or offers to provide, in return for the separate payment of money or other valuable consideration, any of the following services: (1) Improving a consumer's credit record, history or rating; (2) Arranging for or obtaining an extension of credit for a consumer; or (3) Providing advice or assistance to a consumer with respect to subparagraph (1) or (2).

pre_contract_information_sheet_required.quote: Before any agreement is entered into, or before any money is paid by a consumer, whichever occurs first, the loan broker shall provide the consumer with written disclosure of material consumer protections

waiver_of_consumer_rights_prohibited.quote: The duties and standards of care created in this section may not be waived or modified.

value: A supervised lender other than a supervised financial organization (except when acting solely as a loan broker)
A person licensed by the Real Estate Commission to the extent engaged in activities regulated by that commission
A person currently admitted to the practice of law in this State

An affiliate of a supervised lender when providing services for or on behalf of that supervised lender without consumer compensation

A person who performs marketing services for a creditor without consumer compensation

An employee of a seller of consumer goods or services providing credit services in connection with a sale without consumer compensation
excluded_entity_types.quote: "Loan broker" does not include: (1) A supervised financial organization; (2) A supervised lender other than a supervised financial organization
